en: Black‑and‑white view of a newly built residential street on a slope, showing several adjoining two‑ to three‑storey plastered houses with steep tiled gable and hipped roofs, dormers, and decorative shutters. In the unpaved road at left a horse‑drawn carriage travels uphill. A low stone wall and wooden fencing line the foreground; fields and a larger building with a tower‑like roof appear in the background. The scene looks semi‑rural and early‑20th‑century European. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.
